Excellent pizza
Sep 2026 • Couples
Really excellent. Restaurant with nice decor, attentive staff, sophisticated food. You can see that there is excellent work behind it. My partner ate an excellent margherita pizza, really good. I had a carbonara and here, as an Italian, I cannot help but offer a small criticism. No truffle! The dish was very good, but in fact it seemed more like pasta with truffle and guanciale. I appreciate the effort to highlight that the eggs are from cage-free hens, but at least I would specify that there is truffle, which does not belong in a carbonara!
The pizza dough with oil and grated cheese, brought while waiting, was appreciated.
Reasonable price. You absolutely must make a reservation, otherwise you risk a long wait or having to sit outside.

Solid Pizza and Pasta Experience in Hanoi
Jul 2026 • Couples
I read that Pizza 4P’s Trang Tien is one of the nicer branches in Hanoi, so I had to try it. Reservations are definitely recommended. We first came around 11 AM and were told the next available table was at 1 PM, so we came back later and luckily got a table.

We ordered the Carbonara, Crab Tomato Cream Spaghetti with Ricotta Cheese, and a half and half pizza. The Soy Garlic Beef Pizza was so damn good, loaded with tender beef and full of flavor. The Three Cheese Pizza was not really our favorite.

The service was so damn good. The servers were attentive, courteous and genuinely made the experience better.

The ambiance is intimate, industrial and moody, and the Trang Tien location is perfect after shopping or walking around the area. Definitely worth trying if you want something a little more elevated in Hanoi. Moderate value for money, but overall a great experience.

Be sure to eat this exploding 🔥 pizza in Vietnam!
Jun 2026 • Friends
Why would I highly recommend a pizza when eating local food every day in Vietnam? Originally wanted to go to Pizza 4P’s, in fact for a simple reason, it was so hot in Vietnam, and has been recommended, out of sheer curiosity, figure out a fresh punch to see why it is so popular. What really made me decide that I had to save a meal for eating was after seeing the menu. In addition to the classic flavors, you can also see a lot of combinations of ingredients and flavors that incorporate Vietnamese, making it feel like it's not moving foreign pizza to Vietnam, but making a very Vietnamese-style pizza restaurant, which is why I want to try it most.

The store can order Half & Half pairs, which can be eaten in two flavors at a time, without having to struggle with which one to choose, perfect for choosing difficulties. It is highly recommended to order the signature fresh brata ham pizza. The whole cheese is sliced and the rich fresh milk bursts out with milk, accompanied by a freshly baked kiln-thin base and salty ham. It's amazing!

The other half was left with their family's ultra-featured Pho pizza, which was supposed to be a gimmick, only to be stunned at the first bite! Traditional nine-story towers, coriander and other parsleys, with tender beef fillets and special river flour flavor sauces, bite down is really full of mouthfuls of extremely authentic Vietnamese river flour aroma, this Italian and Vietnamese style of wonderful collision, nowhere else to eat!

The price is not cheap, but the overall experience is worth it, the environment is also comfortable, wooden decoration is very textured, when eating tired Vietnamese food can really come to experience, anyway I was after eating thinking about next time.

Apr 2026 • Couples
Read up on this place before trying and it lived up to its reputation. Tip - book at least a day in advance as no guarantee you’ll be seated if you wait in queue.
